justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists private work order types to verify the user's Itcons.app credentials and does not modify data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the authenticated user's private Itcons.app workspace and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists calendars from the authenticated user's private Itcons.app workspace and does not modify them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses the authenticated user's bounded private workspace and does not access public or open-ended internet data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one authorized private calendar and returns its holidays within a caller-supplied bounded date range.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the authenticated user's private Itcons.app calendar and does not query public internet sources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the calendar or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one private calendar and computes working days locally for a maximum inclusive range of 366 days.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only the authenticated user's bounded private calendar and no public or open-ended external data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs a local calculation without creating, updating, deleting, or overwriting records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the private leave-type catalog and does not retrieve employee leave records or modify data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a bounded catalog from the authenticated user's private Itcons.app workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, overwrite, or approve leave information.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists authorized projects and returns a reduced operational view capped at 50 items without modifying project data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads projects from the authenticated user's bounded private Itcons.app workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, archive, delete, or overwrite projects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists authorized work orders and returns a reduced operational view capped at 50 items without notes, people, locations, or attachments.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads work orders from the authenticated user's bounded private Itcons.app workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, assign, start, complete, update, archive, or delete work orders.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only fetches private work report model records and returns them without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the user's private Itcons.app workspace and does not touch public internet surfaces.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves private work reports by query parameters and does not create or update reports.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the authenticated user's private Itcons.app workspace and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove data or perform irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only fetches private work reports and filters them by date without modifying stored records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads closed Itcons.app data and does not publish or send information to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the user's private Itcons.app workspace and does not touch public internet state.
